objects.definition:
enum class Activation {
	ReLU,
	LeakyReLU,
	SiLU,
	Exponential,
	Sine,
	Sigmoid,
	Squareplus,
	Softplus,
	Tanh,
	None,
};
objects.description: Enumeration of activation functions supported by tiny-cuda-nn components. Values identify the nonlinearity to apply in neural network layers.
Enumeration of grid storage/layout types for multi-resolution grids or similar structures: hashed, dense, or tiled.
Enumeration of hashing strategies used for grid indexing or parameter hashing.
Enumeration of interpolation kernels for sampling grid data.
Enumeration describing memory layout of 2D data: row-major/SoA or column-major/AoS. Constants RM/SoA and CM/AoS alias the enum values in this header.
Enumeration of reduction strategies to combine values across dimensions or features.
Simple ray type with origin o and direction d (vec3). Provides evaluation at parameter t, advancement, distance to a point, validity check, and a factory for an invalid ray.

functions.name: tcnn::PI
functions.signature: inline constexpr TCNN_HOST_DEVICE float tcnn::PI()
functions.description: Returns the constant pi as a 32-bit float (3.14159265358979323846f). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None beyond standard function call requirements.

functions.name: tcnn::host_device_swap
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::host_device_swap(T& a, T& b)
functions.description: Swaps the values of a and b by copy (uses a temporary). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must be copy-constructible and assignable.

functions.name: tcnn::gcd
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::gcd(T a, T b)
functions.description: Computes the greatest common divisor of a and b using the Euclidean algorithm. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support the modulo operator (%) and copy/assignment.
If T is signed, behavior with negative values follows C/C++ modulo semantics.
No division-by-zero occurs internally; the loop guards against a == 0.

functions.name: tcnn::lcm
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::lcm(T a, T b)
functions.description: Computes the least common multiple of a and b as (a / gcd(a,b)) * b. Returns 0 if both inputs are 0. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support gcd-compatible operations: %, /, *, comparisons, and copy/assignment.
Potential for arithmetic overflow if |(a/ gcd(a,b)) * b| exceeds T's range.

functions.name: tcnn::div_round_up
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::div_round_up(T val, T divisor)
functions.description: Performs integer-style division with rounding up: (val + divisor - 1) / divisor. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: divisor must be non-zero.
T must support +, -, /, and copy/assignment.
Intended for integer-like types; for floating types, semantics still follow the expression but may not represent typical rounding-up intent.

functions.name: tcnn::next_multiple
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::next_multiple(T val, T divisor)
functions.description: Rounds val up to the next multiple of divisor using div_round_up(val, divisor) * divisor. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: divisor must be non-zero.
T must support +, -, /, *, and copy/assignment.

functions.name: tcnn::previous_multiple
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::previous_multiple(T val, T divisor)
functions.description: Rounds val down to the previous multiple of divisor using (val / divisor) * divisor. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: divisor must be non-zero.
T must support /, *, and copy/assignment.

functions.name: tcnn::is_pot
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
constexpr TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::is_pot(T val)
functions.description: Checks if val is a power of two using (val & (val - 1)) == 0. Usable from host and device code. Note: For val == 0 this expression evaluates to true in this implementation.
requirements: T must support bitwise operators (&) and subtraction.
Intended for integer types; undefined or illogical for non-integer types.

functions.name: tcnn::next_pot
functions.signature: inline constexpr TCNN_HOST_DEVICE uint32_t tcnn::next_pot(uint32_t v)
functions.description: Computes the next power-of-two greater than or equal to v using bit-twiddling. For v == 0, returns 0.
requirements: Input is a 32-bit unsigned integer.
For v > 0, returns a power-of-two in [1, 2^32); for v == 0, result is 0.

functions.name: tcnn::default_loss_scale
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
constexpr TCNN_HOST_DEVICE float tcnn::default_loss_scale()
functions.description: Returns the default loss scale for mixed-precision training for type T. Only explicit specializations are defined in this header.
requirements: Only the provided specializations are defined here; calling this primary template for other T will require a definition elsewhere or will be a link-time error.

functions.name: tcnn::n_blocks_linear
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
constexpr TCNN_HOST_DEVICE uint32_t tcnn::n_blocks_linear(T n_elements, uint32_t n_threads = N_THREADS_LINEAR)
functions.description: Returns the number of thread blocks needed to cover n_elements with n_threads threads per block using div_round_up. Useful for launching CUDA kernels.
requirements: n_threads must be > 0 to avoid division by zero.
T must support addition, subtraction, division, and conversion to the expression type used in div_round_up.

functions.name: tcnn::PitchedPtr::operator()
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T* tcnn::PitchedPtr<T>::operator()(uint32_t y) const
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the y-th row given a base pointer and stride_in_bytes. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: ptr must be non-null to dereference the returned pointer.
y must be within the bounds of the allocated pitched memory described by stride_in_bytes.
stride_in_bytes must have been initialized correctly for the memory layout.

functions.name: tcnn::PitchedPtr::operator+=
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::PitchedPtr<T>::operator+=(uint32_t y)
functions.description: Advances the internal pointer forward by y rows using the configured stride. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Resulting pointer must remain within the allocated memory region.
stride_in_bytes must be set correctly.

functions.name: tcnn::PitchedPtr::operator-=
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::PitchedPtr<T>::operator-=(uint32_t y)
functions.description: Moves the internal pointer backward by y rows using the configured stride. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Resulting pointer must remain within the allocated memory region.
stride_in_bytes must be set correctly.

functions.name: tcnn::PitchedPtr::operator bool
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE explicit tcnn::PitchedPtr<T>::operator bool() const
functions.description: Checks whether the internal pointer is non-null. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::operator()
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T& tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::operator()(signed_index_t i, signed_index_t j = 0) const
functions.description: Returns a reference to the element at row i and column j using signed indexing and custom strides. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: data must be non-null to dereference.
i and j must reference elements within the underlying allocated matrix region as laid out by stride_i and stride_j.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::advance
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::advance(signed_index_t m, signed_index_t n)
functions.description: Advances the internal data pointer by m rows and n columns using signed indexing. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Resulting pointer must remain within the allocated matrix region.
stride_i and stride_j must have been set correctly.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::advance_rows
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::advance_rows(signed_index_t m)
functions.description: Advances the internal data pointer by m rows (signed). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Resulting pointer must remain within the allocated matrix region.
stride_i must have been set correctly.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::advance_cols
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::advance_cols(signed_index_t n)
functions.description: Advances the internal data pointer by n columns (signed). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Resulting pointer must remain within the allocated matrix region.
stride_j must have been set correctly.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::row
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
template <uint32_t N>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE tvec<std::remove_const_t<T>, N> tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::row(unsigned_index_t m) const
functions.description: Returns the m-th row as a fixed-size vector of length N by reading consecutive columns [0..N-1]. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: data must be non-null to read.
The row must have at least N accessible columns given stride_j.
Indices accessed must lie within the allocated matrix region.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::col
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
template <uint32_t N>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE tvec<std::remove_const_t<T>, N> tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::col(unsigned_index_t n) const
functions.description: Returns the n-th column as a fixed-size vector of length N by reading consecutive rows [0..N-1]. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: data must be non-null to read.
The column must have at least N accessible rows given stride_i.
Indices accessed must lie within the allocated matrix region.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::set_row
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
template <typename U, uint32_t N, size_t A>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::set_row(unsigned_index_t m, const tvec<U, N, A>& val)
functions.description: Writes the values of val into row m across columns [0..N-1]. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: data must be non-null to write.
Row m must have at least N accessible columns given stride_j.
Types T and U must be assignable/convertible for element-wise assignment.
Indices written must lie within the allocated matrix region.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::set_col
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
template <typename U, uint32_t N, size_t A>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::set_col(unsigned_index_t n, const tvec<U, N, A>& val)
functions.description: Writes the values of val into column n across rows [0..N-1]. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: data must be non-null to write.
Column n must have at least N accessible rows given stride_i.
Types T and U must be assignable/convertible for element-wise assignment.
Indices written must lie within the allocated matrix region.

functions.name: tcnn::MatrixView::operator bool
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename STRIDE_T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE explicit tcnn::MatrixView<T, STRIDE_T>::operator bool() const
functions.description: Checks whether the underlying data pointer is non-null. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::operator<
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::Interval<T>::operator<(const Interval& other) const
functions.description: Comparison operator used to sort non-overlapping intervals. Orders primarily by end, with tie-breaker on start when ends are equal. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Intervals may be empty; comparison remains well-defined.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::overlaps
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::Interval<T>::overlaps(const Interval& other) const
functions.description: Returns true if this interval overlaps with other (non-empty intersection). Intervals are half-open [start, end). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: Assumes the half-open interval semantics; works even if one or both intervals are empty.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::intersect
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE tcnn::Interval<T> tcnn::Interval<T>::intersect(const Interval& other) const
functions.description: Returns the intersection of two half-open intervals [start, end) as a new Interval. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None beyond valid arithmetic on T.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::valid
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::Interval<T>::valid() const
functions.description: Returns true if end >= start (interval has non-negative size). Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support comparison operators.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::empty
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::Interval<T>::empty() const
functions.description: Returns true if the interval is empty (end <= start) under half-open semantics. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support comparison operators.

functions.name: tcnn::Interval::size
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE T tcnn::Interval<T>::size() const
functions.description: Returns the size (length) of the interval as end - start. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support subtraction (end - start).

functions.name: tcnn::Ray::operator()
functions.signature: TCNN_HOST_DEVICE tcnn::vec3 tcnn::Ray::operator()(float t) const
functions.description: Evaluates the ray at parameter t: o + t * d, returning the 3D point. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None. For meaningful results, the direction d should be set appropriately.

functions.name: tcnn::Ray::advance
functions.signature: TCNN_HOST_DEVICE void tcnn::Ray::advance(float t)
functions.description: Advances the ray origin by t along its direction: o += d * t. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None. For meaningful results, the direction d should be set appropriately.

functions.name: tcnn::Ray::distance_to
functions.signature: TCNN_HOST_DEVICE float tcnn::Ray::distance_to(const tcnn::vec3& p) const
functions.description: Computes the shortest Euclidean distance from the ray to point p. Uses projection onto the ray direction. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: The ray direction d must be non-zero to avoid division by zero; check is_valid() before calling.

functions.name: tcnn::Ray::is_valid
functions.signature: TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::Ray::is_valid() const
functions.description: Returns true if the ray direction d is non-zero. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tcnn::Ray::invalid
functions.signature: static TCNN_HOST_DEVICE tcnn::Ray tcnn::Ray::invalid()
functions.description: Returns an invalid ray with zero origin and zero direction. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: None.

functions.name: tcnn::PayloadAndIdx::operator<
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
TCNN_HOST_DEVICE bool tcnn::PayloadAndIdx<T>::operator<(const PayloadAndIdx<T>& other)
functions.description: Comparison operator for sorting by t. Returns true if this.t < other.t. Usable from host and device code.
requirements: T must support operator< for comparison.
